notes: Class Ib high-toxicity carbamate under phased restriction/state-level bans in India; high bird and groundwater toxicity; requires agronomist warning of restricted status.
CIBRC approved label claim for Yellow Stem Borer on rice. Standard dilution: 150 ml in 500 L water/ha. Waiting period (PHI): 47 days. Green label anthranilic diamide.
CIBRC approved for rice BPH/GLH. Note: CIBRC standard label dosage for Buprofezin 25% SC is 800 ml/ha in 500 L water (source quotes 400 ml/ha). Spray must be directed at plant base.
CIBRC approved label claim for Leaf folder on rice at 150 ml/ha in 500 L water. PHI: 47 days. Safe to beneficial natural predators.
CIBRC approved for rice leafhoppers at 100-125 ml/ha in 500 L water. Effective against GLH vector to prevent Tungro virus spread. PHI: 21 days.
